items.title: Show HN: Can a VPN be decentralised.. I think it's the best for homelabs
items.summary: Can a VPN be decentralised... I was trying out tailscale for my homelab but I didn't really want a control plane. Tailscale, Headscale and others already do the Controlled VPN extremely well, and I've used them. but every one of them has a control plane that all the devices directly connect to.
